unit: Algebra · Chapter 1. Power and exponential functions
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: y = aˣ (a > 0, a ≠ 1) is the exponential function: domain ℝ, range (0; +∞), and its graph passes through (0; 1).
stages.headlineEnglish: y = aˣ (a > 0, a ≠ 1) is the exponential function: domain ℝ, range (0; +∞), and its graph passes through (0; 1).

stages.headline: For a > 1 the exponential function increases, for 0 < a < 1 it decreases; hence /K a^{x_{1}} K/ = /K a^{x_{2}} K/ exactly when x₁ = x₂.
stages.headlineEnglish: For a > 1 the exponential function increases, for 0 < a < 1 it decreases; hence a^x₁ = a^x₂ exactly when x₁ = x₂.

stages.headline: Examples: /K 3^{0.7} K/ > /K 3^{0.5} K/ since 3 > 1, but 0.2³ < 0.2² since 0 < 0.2 < 1.
